$comment: Database monitoring alert rules for scripts/db/monitoring/check.mjs. Dependency-free JSON; see docs/runbooks/database-monitoring.md for severity/runbook mapping. `type`: sql (single value from first column of first row), sql-path (query returns a filesystem path that is statfs'ed for used fraction), file (scan a directory for file age/count). Thresholds: a result is 'critical' when value compares true against `critical`, else 'warning' against `warn`, else 'ok' (default op '>'). `demo` is the sample value used by --dry-run. A NULL SQL value or an empty/missing file dir yields 'skipped' unless overridden.

rules.title: Connection pool saturation
rules.description: Fraction of max_connections currently used by pg_stat_activity. PrismaPg pools per process; sustained saturation means new queries queue or fail.
rules.query: SELECT count(*)::float8 / GREATEST((SELECT setting::float8 FROM pg_settings WHERE name = 'max_connections'), 1) AS value FROM pg_stat_activity

rules.title: Idle in transaction sessions
rules.description: Sessions sitting 'idle in transaction' hold locks and block vacuum. Count from pg_stat_activity.
rules.query: SELECT count(*)::int AS value FROM pg_stat_activity WHERE state = 'idle in transaction'

rules.title: Slow / long-running queries
rules.description: Age in seconds of the oldest currently active query (excluding this monitor's own backend). Catches runaway queries even when pg_stat_statements is not enabled.
rules.query: SELECT COALESCE(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM max(now() - query_start)), 0)::float8 AS value FROM pg_stat_activity WHERE state = 'active' AND pid <> pg_backend_pid()

rules.title: Replication lag (stubbed)
rules.description: Seconds of replay lag on the most-lagged standby, from pg_stat_replication. Returns NULL (skipped) on a single-node deployment with no replicas; wire a real replica or a pg_stat_monitor feed before relying on this alert in production.
rules.query: SELECT CASE WHEN count(*) = 0 THEN NULL ELSE COALESCE(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM max(replay_lag)), 0) END::float8 AS value FROM pg_stat_replication

rules.title: Disk usage on database volume
rules.description: Used fraction of the filesystem containing PostgreSQL's data_directory (from SHOW data_directory via pg_settings, statfs'ed locally — run the checker on the DB host for remote databases).
rules.query: SELECT setting AS value FROM pg_settings WHERE name = 'data_directory'

rules.title: Dead tuples / table bloat
rules.description: Ratio of dead to total tuples across pg_stat_user_tables. High ratios mean autovacuum is not keeping up and queries are scanning dead rows.
rules.query: SELECT CASE WHEN sum(n_live_tup + n_dead_tup) = 0 THEN NULL ELSE sum(n_dead_tup)::float8 / sum(n_live_tup + n_dead_tup) END AS value FROM pg_stat_user_tables

rules.title: Failed or interrupted migrations
rules.description: Rows in _prisma_migrations with finished_at IS NULL — a deploy was interrupted mid-migration or a migration failed. Any non-zero count is critical.
rules.query: SELECT count(*)::int AS value FROM _prisma_migrations WHERE finished_at IS NULL

rules.title: Backup staleness
rules.description: Age in hours of the newest file in the backup directory (MONITOR_BACKUP_DIR, default backups/). Works without a database connection. An existing-but-empty directory is critical; a missing directory is skipped.
